steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Component 3: perform two extracts from ONE play — assessed by a visiting examiner.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Group work: you are assessed INDIVIDUALLY even in a group performance — you must maintain character and focus throughout.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Preparation: full dress and technical rehearsals before the exam day — no surprises on the day.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Focus under pressure: if something goes wrong, STAY IN CHARACTER and adapt — the examiner assesses how you handle the moment.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: The examiner assesses from the MOMENT you enter the performance space Individual marks — your group's weakness should not drag you down if you perform well Cover mistakes IN CHARACTER — never acknowledge them Full costume, make-up and props show professionalism and commitment
